title: Fix: federation handshake with Mastodon
notes: Outgoing federation requests signed the content-type header, which Mastodon validates differently — so Mastodon rejected our follow acknowledgements and deliveries. The signature no longer covers content-type, so follows complete and topics/replies reach the fediverse.

changelog.text: Federation HTTP signatures no longer sign content-type, fixing follow acceptance and delivery to Mastodon.
